sahneler.metin: A tanker truck crashed and caught fire under Interstate 95 in Philadelphia.
Within minutes, the heat caused the northbound lanes to collapse.
Its driver lost control on a curve.
The tank ruptured under the overpass.
The heat weakened the structure above.
A temporary road reopened I-95 in under two weeks.

aciklama:
I-95 Philadelphia collapsed after a tanker fire underneath. The cause: extreme heat from burning gasoline weakening the overpass.
